title: Dense decoder baseline
summary: Build and probe the ordinary tied-embedding dense decoder directly; no campaign is required to inspect its forward shapes or initialized behavior.

steps.explanation: Token IDs are embedded, processed by pre-norm causal decoder blocks, normalized, and projected through the tied vocabulary head.
observe: No dense-attention-specific architecture metric is emitted.

steps.explanation: Dense attention applies RoPE to causal queries and keys; positions cannot attend to future tokens.
RMSNorm and RoPE are ordinary decoder components, not separate memory mechanisms.
observe: RMSNorm and RoPE module hook records

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer and dataset before training; a probe only needs the tokenizer.
try_changes: Predict the [B,T,V] logit shape before probing.
Change exactly one ordinary model knob, then compare the hook shapes.
Train briefly and compare training-format acquisition with held-out wording rather than assuming initialized behavior is learned behavior.
limits: This is a readable PyTorch reference implementation, not a speed claim.
A probe uses fresh initialized weights and is mechanism evidence only, not evaluation evidence.
